items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: I went to Marrero's right after Kid Thomas.

ctx.x: I've never been in there. I don't blame. Oh, yes.
But would you play, I was playing the Marrero's at Fajro? Would you play in the Coconut Grove? Yeah. I went to Marrero's right after Kid Thomas.
Well, it was at the Grove, yeah.
